resources.string: Tap to turn wireless debugging on or off and see the address your Mac connects to.
Wireless debugging, %1$s. Double tap to switch.
Wireless debugging from Quick Settings, your home screen, and the Connect Android Mac app.
Turn it on here, from the tile, or from the widget.
Finish the one-time Mac setup below to control it from this phone.
Wireless debugging lives in Developer options. Turn that on first.
Android only lets a computer grant control of wireless debugging. Open Connect Android on your Mac while this phone is connected and click Allow phone controls. Or run this once:
This grants WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS. Connect Android only changes wireless debugging and pairing expiry with it. Uninstalling the app removes the grant.
Settings → About phone → Software information → tap Build number seven times. Then come back here.
Turn back on when Wi-Fi reconnects

Android turns wireless debugging off whenever Wi-Fi drops. This turns it back on when Wi-Fi returns and after a restart, and nothing runs in between. On a new network, tick "Always allow on this network" once.
Android forgets a paired computer after 7 days of disuse, which forces a new QR scan.
Open Quick Settings edit mode and drag Wireless debugging into place.
Follow your launcher\'s prompt to place the widget.
Long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, and add Connect Android.
